answer: Proof-of-personhood via a scarce credential: every agent must sign its bids with a key that has slowly climbed a reputation ladder, like a climber grinding toward a summit one rope length at a time. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh keys by night, but each starts at the bottom and the gale of the market strips weak, untested identities fast. Reputation is spent, not just earned: bidding high burns a little quill of your written history, so fake voters pay real cost while honest agents keep compounding standing.
